label: V1 (VANOSRT2)
title: VANOS minimum RPM
user_description: Legacy MS41.1 VANOS revision. Its Original VANOS logic setting can allow engagement in the 8,160 RPM bin. Upgrade to V2 to keep the factory decision.
description: VANOSRT2 is retained for exact detection, upgrade and removal. V1 compares all settings, including the reserved default 0xFF, against the RPM mirror. The threshold is stored at SA 0x3720 and the marker at SA 0x3728.
